title: The Broken Covenant

questions.question: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord: "Hear the words of this..., and speak to the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:2 (ESV): "Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem."

questions.question: "Cursed be the man who does not hear the words of this covenant that I commanded your fathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:3-4 (ESV): "that I commanded your fathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace,"

questions.question: "...saying, Listen to my voice, and do all that I command you. So shall you be my people, and I will be your God, that I may confirm the... that I swore to your fathers,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:4-5 (ESV): "that I may confirm the oath that I swore to your fathers,"

questions.question: What land did the Lord swear to give their fathers?
options: A land flowing with milk and honey
A land of wheat and barley
A land of hills and valleys
questions.correctAnswer: A land flowing with milk and honey
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:5 (ESV): "a land flowing with milk and honey, as at this day."

questions.question: "But they did not obey or incline their ear, but everyone walked in the stubbornness of his... heart."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:8 (ESV): "but everyone walked in the stubbornness of his evil heart."

questions.question: The Lord said to Jeremiah, "A... has been found among the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:9 (ESV): "A conspiracy has been found among the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem."

questions.question: "They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after... to serve them."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:10 (ESV): "They have gone after other gods to serve them."

questions.question: What two houses did the Lord say had broken the covenant he made with their fathers?
options: The house of Israel and the house of Judah
The house of David and the house of Saul
The house of Joseph and the house of Benjamin
The house of Levi and the house of Aaron
questions.correctAnswer: The house of Israel and the house of Judah
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:10 (ESV): "The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant that I made with their fathers."

questions.question: "Therefore, thus says the Lord, Behold, I am bringing disaster upon them that they cannot escape. Though they... to me, I will not listen to them."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:11 (ESV): "Though they cry to me, I will not listen to them."

questions.question: "Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to whom they make offerings, but they cannot... them in the time of their trouble."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:12 (ESV): "but they cannot save them in the time of their trouble."

questions.question: "For your gods have become as many as your..., O Judah; and as many as the streets of Jerusalem are the altars you have set up to shame, altars to make offerings to..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:13 (ESV): "For your gods have become as many as your cities, O Judah; and as many as the streets of Jerusalem are the altars you have set up to shame, altars to make offerings to Baal."

questions.question: "Therefore do not... for this people, or lift up a cry or prayer on their behalf, for I will not listen when they call to me in the time of their trouble." (spoken to Jeremiah)
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:14 (ESV): "Therefore do not pray for this people,"

questions.question: Jeremiah said he was like a gentle... led to the slaughter, completely unaware of the plots against him.
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:19 (ESV): "But I was like a gentle lamb led to the slaughter."

questions.question: Who plotted against Jeremiah, saying, "Let us destroy the tree with its fruit, let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name be remembered no more"?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:21 (ESV): "Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, and say, 'Do not prophesy in the name of the Lord...'"

questions.question: What did the Lord promise to do to the men of Anathoth who sought Jeremiah's life?
options: Punish them, young men dying by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine
questions.correctAnswer: Punish them, young men dying by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 11:22 (ESV): "Behold, I will punish them. The young men shall die by the sword, their sons and their daughters shall die by famine,"

key_verse_text: "They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant that I made with their fathers."
